after.zh: 把放大回来的粗结果和原尺寸的细结果合起来：粗的一路挡住噪点，细的一路留下细节。这条从编码器直接连到解码器的线叫跳连，U-Net 每一层都有。
after.en: Combine the coarse result enlarged back with the fine result at full size: the coarse path keeps out the grain, the fine path keeps the detail. This line straight from encoder to decoder is called a skip connection, and U-Net has one at every level.

t.zh: 细胞常常挤在一起，中间只隔一条极细的缝。数细胞时，缝丢了，两个就算成一个。
t.en: Cells often crowd together with only a very thin gap between them. When counting, lose the gap and two count as one.

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：标出细胞，细胞之间的缝要留着。
t.en: Your task in this level: mark the cells, keeping the gaps between them.

brief.zh: 挨在一起的细胞之间只隔一条一像素的暗缝。标出细胞，缝要留着（0）。
brief.en: Touching cells are separated only by a dark gap one pixel wide. Mark the cells, and keep the gaps (0).

hint.zh: 缩小再放大的那条路看不见一像素的缝。原图里还看得见。
hint.en: The shrink-then-enlarge path cannot see a one-pixel gap. The original picture still can.

label.en: Two in a row, gap elsewhere
